title: Canidae zoological detail navigation seed
purpose: Optional vertical drill-down for morphology, physiology, reproduction, and care; excluded from the default ecology-behavior experiment.
evidence_boundary: Only populated dimension claims are admitted. Every populated claim names its source and locator. Unresolved or unsupported dimensions are explicit empty arrays; empty cells are not negative assertions.

eltontraits_1_0_mammals.title: EltonTraits 1.0: Species-level foraging attributes of the world's birds and mammals
eltontraits_1_0_mammals.use: diet composition, activity flags, and body mass

animal_diversity_web_species_accounts.title: Animal Diversity Web species accounts
animal_diversity_web_species_accounts.publisher: University of Michigan Museum of Zoology
animal_diversity_web_species_accounts.use: structured habitat, behavior, reproduction, parental investment, thermoregulation, and body-length observations
animal_diversity_web_species_accounts.evidence_note: Account age and completeness vary by species; source absences are not interpreted as biological absences.

pantheria_1_0_msw05.title: PanTHERIA 1.0: species-level mammal life history, ecology, and geography
pantheria_1_0_msw05.use: canonical adult head-body length cross-check and harmonization
pantheria_1_0_msw05.variable_definition: 13-1_AdultHeadBodyLen_mm: total length from tip of nose to anus or base of tail; consolidated to a sex-unspecified unique median.

body_mass_log_band_v1.method: Use left-closed bands: under 100 g; 100 g to 1 kg; 1 to 10 kg; 10 to 100 kg; 100 to 1000 kg; over 1000 kg.
body_mass_log_band_v1.provenance_boundary: Repository-authored deterministic projection over sourced body mass.

adw_controlled_keyword_normalization_v1.method: Lowercase and convert separators to a stable snake-case value without adding biological meaning.
adw_controlled_keyword_normalization_v1.provenance_boundary: Repository-authored lexical normalization over a sourced controlled keyword.

adw_reproduction_and_care_projection_v1.input: Animal Diversity Web Mating System, Key Reproductive Features, and Parental Investment keywords
adw_reproduction_and_care_projection_v1.method: Place reproductive keywords in reproductive mode and cooperative breeding, explicit parental care, post-independence association, and extended learning in parental care.
adw_reproduction_and_care_projection_v1.provenance_boundary: Repository-authored semantic placement of sourced controlled keywords.

pantheria_adult_head_body_length_band_v1.method: Classify the canonical adult head-body length into under 50 cm, 50 to 75 cm, 75 to 100 cm, or over 100 cm.
pantheria_adult_head_body_length_band_v1.provenance_boundary: Repository-authored deterministic band over an independently defined and consolidated head-body measurement.
